title: Read a paper
summary: Fetches one item's title, authors, date, abstract and link by the id a search returned, from the source it came from.
whenToUse: Use after a search, on the single best match: the one whose title and abstract are really about the topic, not the first result.

arguments.name: id
arguments.description: The id from the search, such as 2410.15285 (arXiv) or the item's address

arguments.name: source
arguments.description: The source the id came from; leave empty when it is the same as the search

example: Read paper 2410.15285 and tell me what it found
_note: `aliases` keeps the AG.2 argument name working: a planner that learned `arxivID` still lands on `id`.
